# Module 6

**Capstone and Agentic Coding**

This module combines optional supported project work with an introduction to
agentic coding.

**Theme:** [AI-Assisted Coding for Bioinformatics](https://hub.bioinformatics.ca/en-ca/workshops/cbw/2026-large-language-models-for-bioinformatics-edmonton-ab-2026).

## Optional Capstone {#capstone}

Day 2, 14:30

Bring a project for optional supported project work.

## Agentic Coding {#agentic-coding}

Day 2, 15:45

Agentic coding for bioinformatics.

### PubMed MCP with Copilot {#pubmed-mcp-with-copilot}

[Download the PubMed MCP Copilot guide](guides/PubMed-MCP-Copilot-Guide.md) for connecting the PubMed MCP server and searching for papers and available full text.

### Participant OpenRouter API keys {#participant-openrouter-api-keys}

Each participant has an individual OpenRouter API key with a $10 spending
limit. These documents are currently accessible only to the workshop
organizer. Ask the organizer to share your assigned document with you, and
keep your key private.
